newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGB futures down on Tokyo stocks, cash bond sales.
newsitem.headline: JGB futures down on Tokyo stocks, cash bond sales.

text.p: The key September Japanese government bond (JGB) futures contract had slipped by mid-morning in Tokyo after Tokyo stocks managed to post some gains, traders said.
The benchmark Nikkei index was at 19,916.19, up 111.81, at 0045 GMT. The market had been closely watching stocks in the wake of Nikkei's fall by more than 500 points on Friday.

Sales of cash bonds by investors were also weakening futures, along with spillover sales after U.S. Treasury bonds fell sharply on Friday. Yield on the key 182nd 10-year cash bond was 2.120 percent against 2.105 percent at Friday's close.
The key September futures contract was at 126.46, down 0.21 from Friday's close.

Traders said that bonds are unlikely to incur any lasting damage from sales today. "These moves are just a natural downward correction after last week's rises. Bonds are looking to verify the downside and then are likely to rise again," one said.

Others added that book-squaring as operators head into summer vacation, along with natural wariness about taking September up much from its currently high levels, was also likely to weigh the topside.
